t: A breadboard-friendly FPGA module for building your own digital circuits and soft processors.
steps: Buy the Cmod A7-35T from Digilent or a distributor such as Jameco.
Get a micro-USB data cable and a solderless breadboard.
Install the free edition of AMD Vivado and plan for a long download.
Download the Cmod A7 master pin file from Digilent's XDC repository.
Load the Digilent out-of-box demo to check that the board works.
Write a tiny Verilog design that blinks the RGB LED.
Unplug any outside supply on the VU pin before connecting USB.
Try openFPGALoader or LiteX later for an open toolchain.
meta: Open Board. From $104. A few stores.
